q: In photometry, the four main quantities are luminous flux, luminous intensity, luminance, and ____.
e: Photometry measures visible light with weights matched to the human eye, about 400 nm to 700 nm. Peak eye sensitivity is green near 555 nm. Main quantities are luminous flux, intensity, luminance and illuminance. Candela is lumen per steradian.

q: Luminous flux is a measurement of the power of visible light produced by a light source, measured in ____.
e: Luminous flux is the visible-light power of a source, measured in lumen. One lumen is 1/683 watt at 555 nm, not at 400 nm. The eye's peak wavelength is why 555 nm is the luminous standard.
